hypotheses.name: ZERO_EXTENSION
hypotheses.support: none beyond the old analyzer's assumption
hypotheses.contradiction: binutils GAS OP_ABS20 rejects >0xEFFFF; QEMU and GAS both expand abs20 high values to 0xFFxxxx

hypotheses.name: SIGN_EXTENSION_RELOC_ABS20
hypotheses.support: QEMU reloc_abs20: addr > 0xEFFFF => addr | 0xF00000; binutils GAS adjust_if_needed and OP_ABS20 use the same threshold
hypotheses.contradiction: no vendor CR16Cplus core manual in the offline set; still an ISA/implementation proof, not an SC14448 bus trace

hypotheses.name: HARDWARE_ALIAS_OR_WINDOW
hypotheses.support: 12 low/high pairs in both images; SC14480 peripheral window is 0x00FFxxxx
hypotheses.contradiction: SC14480 map separates 0x000Fxxxx FLASH from 0x00FFxxxx peripherals; SC14448 differs

hypotheses.name: DIFFERENT_SPACES
hypotheses.support: SC14480 places low range in FLASH/ROM and high range in peripherals; numeric addresses differ
hypotheses.contradiction: SC14448 may differ; low writes cannot target SC14480 FLASH

hypotheses.name: ANALYZER_DECODING_ERROR
hypotheses.support: raw bytes and oracle disassembly agree on abs20 vs pair forms
hypotheses.contradiction: none for address form; physical extension remains unknown

hypotheses.name: CHIP_SPECIFIC_MAP
hypotheses.support: SC14448 has no offline memory map

blocker: The address-space conflict is resolved: the low 0x000Fxxxx values are encoded abs20 fields that expand to 0x00FFxxxx. The remaining uncertainty is SC14448 physical register identity, not address space; it needs an SC14448 map or bus evidence, not SC14480 alone.
